mathematical_review.scope: Source-family equivalence, Discard, exact selectors, GEN/MP including zero aliases, cofinal continuation coding, inherited calibration, ordinary ZFC endpoint and attribution.

machine_review.scope: Exact table/source edits, case/rule counts, startup frames, graph exclusions, independent audit limitations, finite search scopes and reproduction behavior.
machine_review.result: PASS after correcting dense-label wording and specifying Python 3.10+.

review_boundary: Separate agent reviews inside the research collaboration; not an external human endorsement or proof-assistant kernel check.
